coverage.finding: The top-left folio number reads '242' with a superscript 'b' and a trailing dot or colon. The candidate's literal text and uncertainty are adequate.

The source was rechecked across tiles 1 and 2 without duplication. The second title reads as '…kāmbudhi', which is closer to the image than the inventory's '…ārṇava'. The candidate keeps a [reading?] marker, which is appropriate. 'co.', 'Bhāskara[rāya', 'Bhārati)', 'ff.1-41 and 60 ff.(unn.) in various hands, inc.', 'R.L.M., VII, 2267.' and 'n.d.: 101:9-13:D' are confirmed. The final 'D' drops below the line.

The line reads 'Vd. 360(5), Do., Yoginīhṛdaya, extract on dīkṣā. ff.1-5. Cf. L, I, 282, pt. 5. n.d.: 5:9:D'. The initial tick is fused with the 'd'. The 'Do.' ditto relation to b002 directly above is plausible, and its scope is unresolved.

A single line with no shelfmark, rechecked across tiles 3 and 4. The text is largely as the candidate has it. The second-MS range is written with capital-like 'XX' followed by small 'iii' ('XXiii'), not clearly 'XXIII'. The inventory's feature 'rightward arrow' contradicts its own unattached_marks entry. The image shows a left-pointing arrow.
'ā/' in the strip beside b002/b003. The same mark is visible at the left edge of the fol. 243 overview, which confirms it is shared strip content and not separate fol. 243 writing.
'ś/' in the lower strip. It is confirmed in tile 6 (about x 2955-3030, y 4235-4400).
An 'n' with a dot below, followed by an oblique stroke, in the bottom strip. It is confirmed in tile 6. The reading 'ṇ' remains uncertain.
